title: Gremlin Integrations Chart Schema
description: Schema for the Gremlin integrations Helm values

affinity.description: Map of node/pod affinities for the `gremlin-integrations` container

fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the full, generated name of the release's resources.

allowList.description: Whitelist URLs in order to allow access only to specific set of endpoints

tags.description: A string of comma separated key=value pairs that are used to decorate the Gremlin agent with tags.

extraEnv.description: Specify any arbitrary environment variables to pass to the Gremlin Integrations Agent deployment.

url.description: Specifies the http proxy the agent should use to communicate with api.gremlin.com.

resources.description: Set resource requests and limits See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers

certificate.description: Contents of the certificate. Required if using managed secrets of `type=certificate`

key.description: Contents of the private key. Required if using managed secrets of `type=certificate`

managed.description: Specifies whether Gremlin should manage its secrets with Helm

teamID.description: Gremlin Team ID to authenticate with team identifier (e.g. 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111)

teamSecret.description: Gremlin's team secret. Required if using managed secrets of `type=secret` team secret (e.g. 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)

type.description: The type of certificate to use, can be either `certificate` or `secret` Gremlin supports both `certificate` and `secret` types To manage secrets with helm, set `managed=true` and fill in either the certificate auth or secret auth sections

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the Gremlin control plane that the gremlin-integrations Deployment reports to. Override this when running Gremlin Private Edition.

cert.description: The PEM-encoded certificate (expected to be a multi-line string)

key.description: The PEM-encoded private key (expected to be a multi-line string)

name.description: The name of the new secret

enabled.description: Decides whether the Gremlin Integrations Deployment should be configured for a TLS identity

cert.description: The name of the key inside the existing secret that maps to the certificate value

key.description: The name of the key inside the existing secret that maps to the private key value

name.description: The name of the existing secret

cert.description: The ARN for the identity certificate

key.description: The ARN for the identity private key

imagePullSecrets.description: List of Secret names used as image pull secrets for the gremlin-integrations Deployment.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name used when computing the release's derived resource names.

nodeSelector.description: Map of node labels for pod assignment for the `gremlin-integrations` container

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations applied to the gremlin-integrations Deployment's pods.

podSecurityContext.description: A Kubernetes pod-level SecurityContext for the gremlin-integrations Deployment's pod spec.

replicaCount.description: Number of gremlin-integrations Deployment replicas to run.

securityContext.description: A Kubernetes container-level SecurityContext for the gremlin-integrations container.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

create.description: Specifies whether the gremlin-integrations Kubernetes service account should be created by this Helm chart.

name.description: The name of the service account to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

certDir.description: sets the SSL_CERT_DIR environment variable on the both agents. Unlike ssl.certFile, this value accepts only a path to an existing directory on the Kubernetes nodes. This value is ignored when blank or absent.

certFile.description: Add a certificate file to Gremlin's set of certificate authorities. This argument expects a file containing the certificate(s) you wish to add. When set, this chart creates secret (`integrations-ssl-cert-file`) with the contents and passes it to both agents. This value is ignored when blank or absent.

tolerations.description: List of node taints to tolerate for the `gremlin-integrations` container
